# ClickZetta Exporter
<!-- status autogenerated section -->
<!-- end autogenerated section -->

This exporter sends OpenTelemetry logs, traces, and metrics data to [ClickZetta](https://www.yunqi.tech) lakehouse using the ClickZetta Go SDK's BulkLoad API.

## Build

1. Configure the builder:

Option A: Copy the example builder config:

```shell
cp exporter/clickzettaexporter/example/builder-config.yaml cmd/otelcontribcol/builder-config.yaml
```

Option B: Use the default `cmd/otelcontribcol/builder-config.yaml` and append the replace directive:

```yaml
replaces:
  # ... existing replaces ...
  - github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/exporter/clickzettaexporter => ../../exporter/clickzettaexporter
```

2. Build the collector:

```shell
make otelcontribcol
```

3. Build Docker image (optional):

```shell
GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 make otelcontribcol
docker build -f exporter/clickzettaexporter/example/Dockerfile --build-arg TARGETOS=linux --build-arg TARGETARCH=amd64 -t otelcol-clickzetta .
```

## Configuration

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `service` | string | (required) | ClickZetta service endpoint URL |
| `username` | string | (required) | Authentication username |
| `password` | string | (required) | Authentication password |
| `workspace` | string | (required) | ClickZetta workspace name |
| `virtual_cluster` | string | (required) | ClickZetta virtual cluster name |
| `instance` | string | (required) | ClickZetta instance name |
| `schema` | string | `public` | ClickZetta schema name |
| `protocol` | string | `https` | Connection protocol |
| `logs_table_name` | string | `otel_logs` | Table name for logs |
| `traces_table_name` | string | `otel_traces` | Table name for traces |
| `metrics_table_name` | string | `otel_metrics` | Base table name prefix for metrics (creates `_gauge`, `_sum`, `_histogram`, `_summary`, `_exp_histogram` suffixed tables) |
| `create_schema` | bool | `true` | Whether to auto-create tables on startup |
| `retry_on_failure` | object | default | Retry configuration |
| `sending_queue` | object | default | Queue configuration |
| `timeout` | duration | `10s` | Export timeout |

## Example

```yaml
exporters:
  clickzetta:
    service: https://your-service.clickzetta.com
    username: your_username
    password: your_password
    workspace: your_workspace
    virtual_cluster: your_vc
    instance: your_instance
    schema: public
    create_schema: true
    logs_table_name: otel_logs
    traces_table_name: otel_traces
    metrics_table_name: otel_metrics
```

## Data Model

- **Attributes** are stored as native `MAP<STRING, STRING>` columns
- **Simple arrays** (bucket counts, explicit bounds) use native `ARRAY` types
- **Complex nested structures** (events, links, exemplars, quantiles) are JSON-serialized into `STRING` columns
- **Timestamps** use `TIMESTAMP_LTZ` type
- **Data ingestion** uses the BulkLoad API for high-throughput batch writes
